qualification_rule: A ready route needs a durable pre-existing identity in the named fixed community, a healthy hosted operation that is free, bounded and server-side, no account/key/payment/install/terms gate, exact AG URL or credential semantics, and an independently readable identity-bound result. Discovery health, caller-supplied validation, direct-only responses without durable evidence, listings and human/operator identity are insufficient.
